messages:
marie: FYI — customer's production cluster started seeing 503s at ~09:12 PST, p95 token latency spiked. CS escalated. Lara, can you paste the customer timeline?
lara-cs: from customer logs: 09:10 first slow, 09:11 5 errors, 09:12 many timeouts. They’re on dedicated pool 'cust-phi-1' and using v2.3 model (quantized).
alex: pinging infra — any autoscaler errors?
jordan: checked autoscale logs, no scale events. We had a brief GPU OOM on one node at 09:09 but kube drained and restarted, shouldn't cause 503 fanout.
samir: @marie, I just checked Canary routing — we rolled a quantization kernel tweak last night (PR #4572). Canary passed but we didn't run the long-tail latency suite. Rolling that change back now on pool cust-phi-1.
marie: Good catch. What's ETA on rollback? Customer is asking for a workaround window within 2 hours.
samir: Rolling back now, will push patch in ~8–12m, then let it warm for 10m.
devon: I’ll open a short-lived routing rule to divert 30% traffic to the fallback model variant (v2.3-nonq) while rollback runs. PR for routing rule: https://git.redwood/infrakit/rr-1599
lara-cs: Customer wants SLA impact call in 30m if errors continue. They flagged as P1.
marie: Owners: Samir = rollback, Devon = traffic diversion, Jordan = pool health, Alex = monitoring alerts and postmortem stub. Lara = CS lead. I’ll loop in product for customer comms.
alex: I’ll add a synthetic check for that request path and raise an alert if p95 > 700ms.
samir: Rollback applied to cust-phi-1 nodes. Patch id `deploy-rollback-431999`. Watching logs.
samir: logs: "kvcache init ok" then some WARNs for missing fused-kernel, but error rate dropping.
samir: error rate down from 6.2% to 0.9% in last 6m. Keeping eyes on p99.
devon: Routing change in place, 30% to fallback. Verified on canary headers.
jordan: Node that OOMed shows disk pressure metric spike; filing infra follow-up: https://git.redwood/ops/issues/2231
lara-cs: Customer acknowledged workaround and asked for postmortem and timeline for permanent fix.
marie: Next steps — short postmortem draft (Alex), deep infra follow-up (Jordan), kernel/quantization review (Samir + eng-ml), update customer by EOD (Lara + Product). Can we commit owners+ETA?
samir: Will pair with @ingrid (eng-ml) tomorrow 10am PT for kernel rollback root-cause.
jordan: I'll triage the node health and propose mitigation for disk pressure by EOD.
alex: Drafting postmortem now, will ping for reviews. ETA 4pm PT.
devon: Leaving routing rule enabled for 2h then will remove if stable.
marie: Great. Quick CR ping: Samir, your rollback PR #4589 needs one more approval, can someone on eng-ml review?
samir: @ingrid and @felix requested, ingrid is on PTO until tomorrow but felix can do a quick scan.
felix: scanning now, will approve if nothing odd.
samir: thanks.
sre-bot: canary-deploy-bot: canary check OK for rr-1599, 5/5 healthy checks. :white_check_mark:
marie: thanks all — I'll update the incident log and send customer ETA. If anything regresses, call the bridge. :phone:
lara-cs: noted, customer will wait for the 30m check-in.
marie: thread closed for now — will reopen if new errors.
